name: FORBIDDEN SILENVIL
summary:
Your voice can open the way. But it can also lead you into darkness.

FORBIDDEN SILENVIL is a psychological VR survival horror experience built for Meta Quest, where every whisper, every movement, and every decision matters.

After a violent car crash near an isolated chapel, Max finds himself drawn into a place that should have remained forgotten.

The forest is unnaturally quiet. The chapel holds disturbing secrets. And somewhere beyond the reach of your flashlight, something is waiting.
